messages:
Elena (Marketing): Hi all — new draft of the launch post is ready: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LaunchDraft. Please focus on the benchmark narrative and the webinar CTA/lead flow. Short turnaround: final by Friday EOD.
Samir (Product): Quick ask: add a one-paragraph "who this is for" comparing Dedicated vs Private (use cases). Also call out SLA tiers briefly.
Kai (Eng): Benchmarks note: p95/p99 numbers should include seq length and test hardware. I'll add: p99 @ 512 tokens on A100-80GB; cheaper configs on A10G.
Rhea (Sales): We need explicit HubSpot mapping. Hidden fields: team_owner=(sdr|ae), lead_tier=(self-serve|enterprise), source=blog. Also include campaign utm: launch_q2_webinar.
Ivy (Content): Headline options in doc — I'm leaning toward problem-first. I'll tighten the intro and add a short sidebar: "how we measured".
Legal: Please avoid absolutes like "guarantee". Add privacy blurb under the CTA: "We use your email to follow up about product access; we do not sell personal data."
Elena (Marketing): Pasting CTA snippet we'll embed in the post (simple HTML form):
```html
<form action="https://api.hubapi.com/contacts/v1/contact/?hapikey=demo" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="blog" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="launch_q2_webinar" />
  <input type="hidden" name="team_owner" value="enterprise" />
  <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Work email" required />
  <button type="submit">Register for webinar & early access</button>
</form>
```
Marta (Ops): I can provision the HubSpot form and mapping. Please confirm final field list and the test contact we should use. I'll add a rule to tag incoming contacts with "campaign_source: blog".
Rhea (Sales): Test contact: sales+test@redwood.com. Make sure enterprise leads route to AE queue; others to SDR.
Kai (Eng): I'll add the hardware/test rig footnote and a short note about when quantization affects latency.
Ivy (Content): Added microcopy for social promo and trimmed the CTA copy. Please vote on headline by EOD.
Elena (Marketing): Great — final checklist: Kai: benchmark footnote; Marta: HubSpot mapping + test; Legal: privacy blurb confirmed; Ivy: headline. Target publish Monday 9am PT if all green. Any blockers?
Samir (Product): No blockers. Marking as in-review.
Legal: Approved with edits applied.
Marta (Ops): Will post mapping proof in doc comments tonight.
Elena (Marketing): Thanks everyone — will consolidate edits and ping when ready for final sign-off. :rocket
